dedupe_keys.name: composite cascading failures on interdependent networks ieee dataport

description: This dataset gives simulation records and network topologies for studying composite cascading failures, where physical attacks and cyber infections spread across interdependent physical and cyber network layers. It contains synthetic and real-world-inspired interdependent topologies as GraphML files, with separate physical-layer, cyber-layer and inter-layer dependency graphs and PDF renderings, plus simulation CSV files of initial attack and infection nodes, node loads and thresholds, cascade trajectories and reward values for intervention and resource-allocation experiments, documented in a README and data dictionary. It was deposited by J. Wang, Q. Zheng, X. Guo and C. Yu of Tongji University on 6 July 2026 with the DOI 10.21227/40dy-xs89. The 248 MB zip file is available on IEEE DataPort after login, and the page shows a subscription notice; no licence is named. Caveats: the networks are abstract graphs, not engineered infrastructure models, and the CSV files have no header rows. It supports benchmarking of cascade models and learning-based mitigation for cyber-physical infrastructure; a related record is the Cascading Failure Resilience Index model.
